audit.whatIsWrong: The packet itself flags the defect: Vladimir wins 52.64% but the chart hands Cho'Gath four stages to one. The mirror audit has already settled the shape as Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Vladimir / Cho'Gath / Skill / Vladimir.
audit.why: The two directions must agree, and the mirror's version also matches the win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped to match the mirror, in matched full/content pairs, with ratings inverted from the mirror's (5,6,6,4,6,5,4) to (5,4,4,6,4,5,6).

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere despite nine instructions keyed to 'Feast's cooldown'.
audit.why: Rupture 6s at 950 range, Feral Scream 11s, Vorpal Spikes 8s, Feast 80/70/60, against Transfusion 9s falling to 4.6s and Sanguine Pool 28s. Transfusion out-paces Feral Scream from rank 4, which is what makes levels 4-5 yours.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[1..6], spikes[1] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feast was described as healing him. Riot's text says Feast deals true damage and, only if the target dies, he grows and gains maximum health — the healing is Carnivore, off kills. The silence-versus-Pool ordering was never stated either.
audit.why: Feral Scream denies ability casts, so if the silence lands before you press W the pool never comes out — cast order is the whole all-in. That is the most useful sentence available in this matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Feast healing removed and replaced with the growth-on-kill wording; silence-before-Pool written into report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for exactly that. Only take the trade when Cho'Gath's Feast is down.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is live from level 2 on a 28s cooldown — save it for the Rupture knockup, never for Vorpal Spikes chip.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Cho'Gath must walk into your range.
edits.after: Rupture is 950 range on 6s and Feral Scream silences the whole trade. Hold the wave near your side and give ground.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Feast's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: Transfusion falls to 5.7s against his 11s Feral Scream, so poke between silences and bank the small leads.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Cho'Gath's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast is true damage on 80s at rank 1 — magic resist does not help, only staying above the threshold does. Refuse fights while it is up.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Feast's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike but his sustain matches it — force fights on Feral Scream's cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Cho'Gath carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Hemoplague's team-wide amp dwarfs his single-target Feast. Close it before the map decides for you.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Feast: matchup-defining — True-damage execute. Don’t sit low. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rupture: 6s at 950 range — the telegraph is your dodge cue. - Feral Scream: 11s, 300-range cone; land first and your Pool never comes out. - Feast: 80s true damage. - Sanguine Pool: 28s. - Hemoplague: 120s.

edits.before: Track Cho'Gath's Feast: True-damage execute. Don’t sit low. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Feral Scream silences: if it lands before your Pool, the pool never comes out. Cast Pool first.

edits.before: Through levels 4-5 his silence lockdown still dictates every trade in his favour.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tip to you — Transfusion drops to 5.7s and out-paces his 11s Feral Scream.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — his Feast execute threat trades against your Hemoplague scaling.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Feast is true damage on 80s and your magic resist does nothing.

edits.before: His Feast (R) is true damage execute — if you're below its threshold you get one-shot deleted, and it heals him and grows his HP/size. Track Feast cooldown obsessively; your own Hemoplague (R) does more overall once you out-scale, but early Feast is the scarier button.
edits.after: His Feast (R) is true damage on 80s at rank 1 — below its threshold you are deleted outright, and killing you grows his maximum health. Track it obsessively; your Hemoplague does more overall once you out-scale, but early Feast is by far the scarier button.

notes: Feast healing him was the one fabrication: Riot's text gives growth-on-kill, and the healing belongs to Carnivore off any unit kill.
